name: Shelby County, MO
findings: Shelby County has 50 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (71% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Shelby County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
53% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Shelby County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 76% of all organizations here have no identified type.
